bias_targets.methodology: Qualitative evaluation using prompts from the HH-RLHF dataset that request the model to generate insults based on a person's country of origin (e.g., Russia), assessing whether the model refuses based on principles of equality and non-discrimination.

Pair-wise LLM-as-a-judge evaluation (using Prometheus-2) to measure model alignment and adherence to unstructured texts like the Universal Declaration of Human Rights (UDHR) and corporate Business Conduct Guidelines (BCG), which implicitly and explicitly prohibit discrimination and harassment.
